3. Rule R2 (“If someone needs the bald eagle then the bald eagle does not see the squirrel”) with the fact that the bald eagle needs the bald eagle → The bald eagle does not see the squirrel.  
4. Rule R6 (“If someone needs the bald eagle and the bald eagle does not see the squirrel then the bald eagle is nice”) കൂട്ട with the two facts above → The bald eagle is nice.
